meta.title: YoolLive — see where the cargo is without calling the driver
meta.description: The driver installs the app and you see the whole trip: where the truck is, where it stopped, when it arrives, photos of documents at every step. No trackers, no installation. Try it free.

how.title: Up and running in three minutes
how.lead: Nothing to install on the truck. The driver’s smartphone is enough.

steps.title: Create a load
steps.text: Paste an address link from 2GIS, Yandex Maps or Google Maps. The route and travel time are calculated for you.
steps.image: The “Create new load” form: addresses from 2GIS links and the route on the map

steps.title: Send the driver a link
steps.text: Via Telegram or any messenger. The driver opens it and accepts the load with one tap.
steps.image: A Telegram message with the load link

steps.title: Watch the trip
steps.text: Where the truck is, where it stopped, when it arrives. Document photos come in at every step.
steps.image: A load in transit: speed, arrival time, the distance covered on the map

items.title: Tracking even without internet
items.text: No signal on the highway? The phone keeps recording the route and sends it in full as soon as the connection is back.

items.title: Your client stops calling you
items.text: Send them a link: they see where their cargo is. No sign-up needed.

items.title: Downtime you can prove
items.text: You see where the driver stopped and for how long: since 12:10, forty minutes. Nothing to argue about.

items.title: No waybill gets lost
items.text: The driver photographs documents in the app, and the photos land right in the load, not in chats.

items.title: Answer your client right away
items.text: The dashboard calculates how much of the trip is left, so “when will it arrive?” is no longer a question.

items.title: Be the first to know
items.text: You get a notification when the driver has loaded and when the cargo is delivered. Even if you’re not in the dashboard.

items.title: The driver hasn’t vanished. The phone died
items.text: Battery and connection are visible in the dashboard, so you don’t panic for nothing.

items.title: An address in one link
items.text: Paste a link from 2GIS, Yandex Maps or Google Maps, and the address and route are found for you.

items.title: No trackers, no installation
items.text: Works on the driver’s smartphone. Fits hired trucks too, where you can’t put a tracker.

items.title: We save the driver’s battery
items.text: When the truck is parked, the app turns GPS off on its own, and it records location only during a trip.

items.title: The whole team sees one picture
items.text: Dispatchers don’t have to ask each other: all trips are in one place.

items.title: Every trip stays in the history
items.text: All steps, photos and the route are saved. Handy for disputes and reports.

features.title: Tracking even
features.text: On a mountain pass the signal drops, but the driver’s phone keeps recording the route and stores it for up to 14 days. When the network is back, the whole route appears in the dashboard at once.
features.caption: dashboard — “no data” → the full route
features.video: Dashboard: a “No data” badge, the truck frozen; the connection returns and the covered route appears in full

features.title: Your client stops
features.text: Send the recipient a link. They see the cargo on the map and the route covered. No sign-up needed.
features.caption: link for the recipient — no login
features.video: The load page opened from a link on the recipient’s phone: status, battery, the truck on the map

features.title: Downtime
features.text: When the driver stops, the dashboard shows where and since when. Forty minutes at unloading or three hours: now you see it instead of taking someone’s word for it.
features.caption: dashboard — “stopped since …”, the minutes tick
features.video: Dashboard: “Stopped since 05:53”, the tooltip shows 6, then 12 minutes

drivers.title: One button for every step
drivers.text: Accepted the load, loaded, set off, delivered: the driver taps one button and attaches a photo. Works offline, saves battery when parked and tracks location only during a trip.

items.q: What if the driver loses internet?
items.a: Nothing gets lost. The phone stores the route for up to 14 days and sends it as soon as the network is back. While there’s no connection, the dashboard says exactly that, “no data”, instead of showing an old position on the map.

items.q: Do I need to install a tracker on the truck?
items.a: No. The driver’s Android phone or iPhone is enough.

items.q: Does the app drain the battery?
items.a: When the truck is parked, the app turns GPS off on its own. Location is recorded only while the driver has an active load, and the dashboard shows their phone’s battery level.

items.q: What does the client see from the link?
items.a: The load name and status, the truck on the map and the route covered. No sign-up needed.

items.q: Does the driver need to sign up?
items.a: Yes, in the YoolLive app. It takes a minute: sign in with Telegram, Apple or email. If you sent them a load link, the load is accepted automatically after sign-in.
